name: statement-of-applicability
title: Statement of Applicability
for_each: select id,name from frameworks where upper(code)='ISO27001'

sections.title: Scope
sections.sql: select name as framework,auditor,target_date,applicable,excluded,implemented from readiness where id=$1
sections.note: Prepared from the control register. The reasons for inclusion come from the linked risks; the reasons for exclusion are recorded on each control.

sections.title: Controls
sections.sql: select c.control_id,c.refs,c.name,case when c.applicable then 'Yes' else 'No' end as included,coalesce(c.justification,(select 'Treats: '||string_agg(r.name,'; ' order by r.name) from risks r where r.status='open' and upper(c.control_id)=any(string_to_array(upper(replace(coalesce(r.control_refs,''),' ','')),',')))) as justification,c.status from control_status c join frameworks f on upper(f.code)=any(string_to_array(upper(replace(coalesce(c.frameworks,''),' ','')),',')) where f.id=$1 order by c.control_id

name: risk-treatment-plan
title: Risk treatment plan
for_each: select to_char(current_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') as id,'Risk treatment plan '||to_char(current_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') as name

sections.title: Open risks
sections.sql: select name,owner,inherent,treatment,treatment_plan,control_refs,residual,review_on from risk_register where status='open' and $1::text is not null order by residual desc nulls first,inherent desc
sections.note: Residual risk is accepted by each risk owner. Risks with no owner or treatment are listed by /compliance.

name: management-review-pack
title: Management review pack
for_each: select to_char(current_date,'YYYY-MM') as id,'Management review '||to_char(current_date,'YYYY-MM') as name

sections.title: Readiness
sections.sql: select name as framework,ready_pct,evidence_gaps,days_to_target from readiness where $1::text is not null order by target_date nulls last

sections.title: Incidents in the last twelve months
sections.sql: select name,found_on,severity,personal_info,serious_harm,status,root_cause from incidents where found_on>=current_date-365 and $1::text is not null order by found_on desc

sections.title: Open corrective actions
sections.sql: select name,owner,source,due_on from actions where status='open' and $1::text is not null order by due_on nulls last

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select rule,record,finding from compliance_findings where $1::text is not null order by rule,record
sections.note: Inputs the standard asks a management review to consider include audit results, nonconformities and corrective actions, and risk treatment status. Minute the decisions and record the review with add reviews --kind=management-review.

name: trust-summary
title: Security summary for customers
for_each: select to_char(current_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') as id,'Security summary '||to_char(current_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') as name

sections.title: Frameworks
sections.sql: select name as framework,status,certified_until from frameworks where status<>'retired' and $1::text is not null order by name
sections.note: Only implemented controls appear below. Review every line before this leaves the business.

sections.title: Controls in place
sections.sql: select domain,name,refs from control_status where applicable and status='implemented' and evidence_state in ('current','expiring') and $1::text is not null order by domain,control_id

sections.title: Testing
sections.sql: select kind,last_held from review_calendar where last_held is not null and kind in ('penetration-test','restore-test','internal-audit') and $1::text is not null order by kind
